cohort: The study included 50 singleton pregnancies from 22 to <37 weeks of gestation with sustained fetal supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) or atrial flutter (AFL) >=180 beats/min.
finding: Protocol-defined transplacental treatment for fetal SVT and AFL was effective in resolving tachyarrhythmia in 89.8% of cases overall and was generally tolerable, though serious adverse events and neonatal arrhythmia recurrence within 2 weeks after birth were observed.
